# JIIT Youth Club (JYC)

JIIT Youth Club is the student-led campus ecosystem for JIIT Noida. The public JYC website is the canonical place to discover published student clubs, events, fests, moments and campus activity.

## Core public pages
- / — JIIT Youth Club home: clubs, events, fests and student activity discovery.
- /clubs — official published JIIT student clubs and communities.
- /events — official published JYC events, workshops, competitions and campus activities.
- /fests — official published JYC fests and flagship campus events.
- /calendar — JYC events calendar.
- /gallery — official JYC moments and event/fest photo archive.
- /about — JYC purpose, communities and quick-start answers.
- /team — public JYC team information.

## Canonical content rule
Only content published by JYC administrators should be treated as official. Dynamic club and event pages are canonical when they are published and publicly accessible.
